version_localization.promotionalText: Start with a question, draw your cards, and explore the chart behind a reading. Follow up on the same result and revisit saved profiles, inputs, and method limitations.
version_localization.description:
BlindOracle brings traditional chart calculations, interactive card draws, and AI interpretations into a guided experience for cultural exploration, entertainment, and self-reflection.

Start with your question
Describe what is on your mind, choose a profile, and select a reading method. The app explains which details are needed and which can be left blank.

Take part and inspect the result
Select tarot cards yourself or cast a Liu Yao hexagram through an interactive flow. The app performs the calculations and draws. Reading results retain the relevant inputs, cards, or chart so you can see what the interpretation refers to.

Explore ten methods
Try BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Liu Yao, Mei Hua Yi Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Xiao Liu Ren, traditional bone-weight verses, name numerology, Western astrology, and tarot. Each method includes an explanation of its inputs, outputs, references, and calculation limitations.

Continue the same conversation
Ask follow-up questions using the existing reading. Save profiles, chats, and reading records on your device for later reference. These records do not automatically sync with your Apple account. Signing out or deleting an account does not erase local records; they can be removed in the app.

Paper and ink, in two languages
An interface inspired by paper, ink, and cinnabar, designed for iPhone and iPad. Choose Chinese or English for the interface and new replies in Settings.

Account and allowance
Sign in with Apple to use the app. An eligible first-time account receives a welcome allowance. View the remaining percentage and replenish your allowance through Apple In-App Purchase when needed. Online questions, readings, and follow-ups require an internet connection and available allowance.

Online AI processing uses the question, relevant profile details, and context needed for your request. Content passes through the wellecho.cn server to a third-party AI service. Read the in-app privacy policy and take care when entering sensitive information about yourself or others.

BlindOracle does not guarantee predictions. Its content is for entertainment, cultural exploration, and reflection. It is not medical, legal, or investment advice and does not replace professional guidance or your own judgment.
